summary: Section A is mechanistically accurate and well-sourced: two spot-checked PMIDs (31033998 Bianco Endocr Rev 2019, 30817817 Wejaphikul JCEM 2019) resolve exactly to the claimed papers; all seven citations carry correct inline tags with no bare [N]; unit arithmetic (2.3–4.2 pg/mL × 1.536 = 3.5–6.5 pmol/L) is verified; deiodinase physiology, free-fraction rationale, and the serum-fT3 vs tissue-T3 limitation are all correctly rendered against the brief.
